atAGlance: Cá lóc nướng trui is snakehead fish grilled whole, usually with smoky skin, herbs, rice paper, and tamarind or fish sauce.
whatItIs: Cá lóc nướng trui is whole snakehead fish grilled rustic-style, often served with rice paper, herbs, noodles, cucumber, and a salty-sour dip. It is a wrap-and-share fish order.
howToEnjoy: Pull fish from the bones, place it in rice paper with herbs and noodles if served, roll, then dip. Go slowly because whole fish can have small bones.
howLocalsOrder: Order cá lóc nướng trui as a shared grilled fish. Ask for extra rice paper, extra herbs, and whether bones remain before everyone starts rolling.
worthKnowing: This is strongly tied to Mekong Delta-style eating: smoky whole fish, fresh herbs, rice paper, and a hands-on table.
goodToKnow: Whole fish can have bones; ask whether bones remain if that worries you.
